notes: Coverage is incomplete by design: the release blog (ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-meta-model-api/, fetched via web-reader) carries an 'Evaluations' section but zero machine-readable benchmark numbers - all results are chart images (agentic/computer-use/coding scaling charts plus a Meta Internal Coding Bench chart), so no benchmark table exists on the blog itself. Named-only mentions on the blog that produced no rows: Meta Internal Coding Bench (internal, chart-only), DeepSWE (demo caption in OpenCode). The rows above come from the companion official Muse Spark 1.1 Evaluation Report (tier A technical report), whose capabilities/scorecard tables (Table 1, Table 2, Cybench/CTF Tables 3-5, HLE calibration Table 11, SHADE-Arena/GDM tables) are garbled by PDF text extraction (column values concatenated) and therefore were not transcribed into rows per goal.md 12.5 - OCR/vision assistance cannot be the sole evidence. Release date 2026-07-09 taken from the ai.meta.com blog index listing ('July 9, 2026'); the post page itself does not print a date. Upgrade path: human-read the report PDF tables and the blog chart images, then flip rows/add rows and set status=verified.
